name: Cathedral of Light
summary: In Cathedral Square, the Cathedral of Light is the Church of the Holy Light’s chief sanctuary. It is Stormwind’s spiritual heart and the center of human priesthood and the Knights of the Silver Hand.

sections.title: Sanctuary of the Faithful
sections.body:
Archbishop Benedictus leads the faithful from the Cathedral of Light, rebuilt after the First War’s devastation. Archbishop Alonsus Faol and Bishop Benedictus guided its restoration. Its towering form still recalls the city’s resilience.

After the Scourge took Lordaeron during the Third War, the Church moved its seat south to Stormwind. From the great hall, Benedictus gives spiritual guidance to the Alliance.

sections.title: Halls of Devotion and Arms
sections.body:
The Cathedral of Light is a place of prayer and healing. It is also the Knights of the Silver Hand’s main headquarters in the southern kingdoms.

Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker and Duthorian Rall train promising squires in the sacred trials of the Tome of Valor and the Tome of Divinity. High Priestess Laurena teaches acolytes the deepest tenets of the Light. She prepares holy champions to defend the realm from the growing threats of the Defias Brotherhood and the Scourge.

faq.q: Who leads the Church inside the cathedral?
faq.answer: Archbishop Benedictus leads the Church of the Holy Light from Stormwind. After Lordaeron fell and Archbishop Alonsus Faol died, Benedictus took spiritual leadership of the reformed Church.

faq.q: What is the cathedral's connection to the paladins?
faq.answer: The Cathedral of Light is the Knights of the Silver Hand’s headquarters in Stormwind. Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker and Duthorian Rall instruct new squires through sacred trials and direct crusaders against the realm’s enemies.

faq.q: What lies beneath the cathedral floor?
faq.answer: The cathedral’s catacombs lie beneath the main sanctuary. They hold the remains of honored heroes, priests, and paladins.

angles.text: As a paladin, you find your order’s chief hall in Stormwind’s Cathedral of Light. Duthorian Rall and Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker guide you through the sacred trials of the Tomes of Valor and Divinity.

As a priest, you find the Church of the Holy Light’s chief seat in the southern kingdoms at the Cathedral of Light. High Priestess Laurena and Archbishop Benedictus guide your devotion and sacred healing.
